content:

title: During heatwave, solar power supports France’s grid as nuclear output slows
content:
Heatwaves and drought have forced several French nuclear reactors offline, while strong solar generation has helped stabilize the grid.
As solar output falls after sunset, battery storage could help meet high evening demand and reduce reliance on gas-fired generation.

title: El Salvador launches regulatory framework for solar self-consumption
content:
El Salvador has begun implementing its new renewable self-consumption framework, opening procedures for providers and solar PV installations. The regime introduces tax incentives, grid compensation for surplus generation, and provisions for energy storage and distributed self-consumption.

content:

title: Australia’s Cheaper Home Batteries Program officially passes 500,000 installations
content: More than 507,000 households, small businesses and community organisations have installed a home battery storage system under Australia's Cheaper Home Batteries Program, according to figures announced by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Energy Minister Chris Bowen.

title: Agastya Energy plans 12 GW ingot, wafer factory in India
content:
Agastya Energy plans to invest INR 78 billion ($815.8 million) to develop a 12 GW ingot and wafer manufacturing facility in Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh. The project will complement its planned 5 GW cell and module manufacturing capacity and strengthen India’s integrated solar supply chain.

title: Solar crosses 3 TW threshold
content:
Global solar capacity has surpassed 3 TW, with China driving much of the recent expansion and emerging markets increasingly contributing to growth. As deployment accelerates, grid infrastructure, energy storage, and demand flexibility will become critical to integrating the next wave of solar capacity.

title: Kinematics acquires RenuTrak to expand solar lifecycle services, repowering leadership
content: Motion control system supplier Kinematics has acquired solar repowering solutions provider RenuTrak. The transaction expands Kinematics' global reach into solar asset operations, maintenance, and tracker repowering.

title: RFP Alert: Central Coast Community Energy seeks power purchase agreements from multiple project categories
content: The RFP, which seeks PPAs with start dates no later than December 31, 2032, includes projects with a capacity of at least 20 MW in a mix of categories that includes renewable generation, storage, resource adequacy and carbon-free or low-carbon generation.

title: Proposed Grid 2.0 protocol would enable “connect and manage” for both load and generation
content: Senior staff at AES Corporation and Fluence have published a protocol designed as a universal means to scale flexible interconnection of both new loads and new generators. They have launched a standards development process modeled after the process that brought forth the internet.

title: From lead gen to PTO: How one AI platform is streamlining solar sales and operations
content: Wave Sales says its new AI voice agents can increase customer satisfaction and cut installer soft costs by helping to guide home solar customers through a multi-month installation process using the company’s proprietary memory layer and industry-specific integrations.
